title: French Moroccan Lamb Biryani
description: A unique fusion of French and Moroccan flavors, featuring tender lamb and aromatic spices. This dish is perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent.
Add the cumin and coriander and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the lamb stock and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the rice according to the package instructions.
Heat oil in a separate pot and add the chopped onions.
Add the cooked rice to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the chopped mint and stir to combine.
To assemble the biryani, place a layer of rice in the bottom of a large serving dish.
Top the rice with a layer of lamb and spoon some of the cooking liquid over the top.
Repeat the layers one more time, finishing with a layer of rice on top.
Cover the dish with foil and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
